class Solution {
    public long maximumBeauty(int[] flowers, long newFlowers, int target, int full, int partial) {
        int n = flowers.length;
        int m = 0;
        int ready = 0;
        for (int f : flowers) {
            if (f >= target) ready++;
            else m++;
        }
        int[] a = new int[m];
        int idx = 0;
        for (int f : flowers) {
            if (f < target) a[idx++] = f;
        }
        java.util.Arrays.sort(a);
        long[] pref = new long[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + a[i];
        }
        long ans = 0;
        for (int p = m; p >= 0; p--) {
            int k = m - p;
            long costComplete = (long)k * target - (pref[m] - pref[p]);
            if (costComplete > newFlowers) {
                break;
            }
            long rem = newFlowers - costComplete;
            long beauty;
            if (p == 0) {
                beauty = (long)n * full;
            } else {
                int low = 0, high = target - 1;
                while (low < high) {
                    int mid = (low + high + 1) >>> 1;
                    long cost = costRaise(a, pref, p, mid);
                    if (cost <= rem) {
                        low = mid;
                    } else {
                        high = mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                beauty = (long)(ready + k) * full + (long)low * partial;
            }
            if (beauty > ans) ans = beauty;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    private long costRaise(int[] a, long[] pref, int p, int v) {
        int lo = 0, hi = a.length;
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
            if (a[mid] < v) {
                lo = mid + 1;
            } else {
                hi = mid;
            }
        }
        int idx = Math.min(lo, p);
        return (long)idx * v - pref[idx];
    }

public String maximumBinaryString(String binary) {
    char[] arr = binary.toCharArray();
